parsed.explanation: Same-sex criminalisation (life imprisonment for men) is secondary but here documented as a police lever: 2018 witch hunt, forced anal examinations, torture in custody, and a committee to identify/punish homosexuals, plus 2024 escalating weaponisation. A June 2024 trans activist was abducted by 12 men, beaten and mutilated, with UN condemnation and no documented remedy; activists report substantial transphobia and violence. No trans-specific presentation/facility law is documented, but state-tolerated targeting, severe custody abuse, and life-maximum exposure on outing outweigh paper non-discrimination policies, placing this in high risk.
